jp:

リョウ

Researcher
The vanguard led by Getter Robo has

Hell Villa's transfer is complete!

早乙女博士

Getter's fighting the giant black

near the castle...

城が バリアみたいなもので

Enma-kun
All right! Now Getter Robo can get into
the castle!

リョウ

Ryo
Storming the castle!

リョウ

Ryo
Oh no!

Researcher

enemy!

Dr. Saotome

研究員

quickly...

leave here under any circumstances!
Don't go walking into the enemy's trap!

area!

早乙女博士

tell you.

{p}

{p}

{p}

Miki-chan!

不動明

{p}

不動明

{p}

{p}

{p}

{p}
